calibration_note: Time-limited at 6000/71000 scenes; p99 drift <1% per 250 scenes over the last 1.25k scenes -- converged. Reachability gate (P_j > 1% of step peak) applied to remove velocity-field extrapolation in density tails. vmax_recommended set to p99.9 (not p99) because the per-cell distribution is heavy-tailed: p99 saturated the whole ego corridor in active scenes; p99.9 corresponds to the typical per-scene maximum, leaving inter-cell gradient visible inside high-risk scenes.
